verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says it sends Slack, Discord, or email notifications the moment conditions you specify are met. That covers chat and email delivery on user-defined conditions. Alongside this it offers custom metric dashboards, but the alerting claim rests on a single homepage line rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which conditions or metrics can trigger alerts and how thresholds are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration that alerting works as claimed.
